defect: An ordinary-marker query with two or more matching TableAlias-bound sources silently binds the first source.

binding_site.expression: var index = visitor.ColumnsProvider.FindAlias(typeof(TableAlias), null, false) ?? throw new BuildSqlCommandException(...)
binding_site.note: NextORM.Core.NormSqlTranslator is an internal static class; TryTranslateMarker (:83) is called exactly once, from TryTranslateColumnReference (:55).

probe_api.semantics: paramIdx is the zero-based ordinal among same-typed, same-fromProjection sources inside the current source scope; paramIdx == null returns the first match with no ambiguity check.

experiment.kind: bounded, SQL-generation only (placeholder connection string, no database opened)

end_to_end.query: ctx.From("t232_sales").Pivot(Sum, margin, quarter, PivotValue.Create("1")).Join(ctx.From("t232_other"), (x,y) => SqlFunctions.Column<int>(x,"quarter") == SqlFunctions.Column<int>(y,"quarter")).Select(p => new { V = capturedPivotValues.Value<decimal?>("[1]") })
end_to_end.emitted_sql:
select t1.[1] as [V]
 from t232_sales pivot (sum(margin) for quarter in ([1])) as [t1]
 join t232_other as [t2] on t1.quarter = t2.quarter
end_to_end.observed: the ordinary marker silently bound the FIRST TableAlias source (t1) although two (t1, t2) are in scope; the marker carries no source argument and never rejects the ambiguity.

discriminator_candidates.verdict: VALID LOCAL DISCRIMINATOR - chosen for the D232-RV5-03 guard
discriminator_candidates.rationale: It is the public interface probe (no new API, no DefaultColumnsProvider change) and asks the same lookup the binding site uses, with the ordinal 1 so a non-null answer proves a second same-typed source is visible in exactly the same scope.

discriminator_candidates.verdict: rejected - this is the defect itself (first-match, no ambiguity check)
rejected - counts any registered source, not same-typed TableAlias sources

conclusion: A valid local discriminator exists: FindAlias(typeof(TableAlias), 1, false) is null when exactly one TableAlias source is in scope and non-null when a second one is. No production change to DefaultColumnsProvider is required (it stays untouched); the guard belongs in NormSqlTranslator.TryTranslateMarker.
